# uptimekuma_proxies (Data Source)

Lists the proxies configured on the Uptime Kuma instance. Credentials are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_proxies" "all" {}

output "default_proxy_id" {
  value = one([for proxy in data.uptimekuma_proxies.all.proxies : proxy.id if proxy.default])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `proxies` (Attributes List) The proxies, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxies))

<a id="nestedatt--proxies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxies`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the proxy is usable.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether it is the default for new monitors.
- `host` (String) Proxy host.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the proxy.
- `port` (Number) Proxy port.
- `protocol` (String) Proxy protocol.
